[EN] Curiosity Killed the Scientist's Assistant
[ES] La curiosidad mató al asistente del científico
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Volvur's a good scientist. A tad eccentric, but good.
[ES] Volvur es un buen científico. Un poco excéntrico, pero bueno.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Your dedication to the Invalesco means a lot.
[ES] Tu dedicación a Invalesco significa mucho.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to {@LinkCreature:245#3511#Volvur} at {@Rgn:45009}.
[ES] Preséntate ante {@LinkCreature:245#3511#Volvur} en {@Rgn:45009}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "At your service."
[ES] "A tu servicio."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Athakela Fang
[ES] Colmillo de athakela
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt {@LinkCreature:45#3004#athakela stalkers} around {@Rgn:45009} and collect their fangs.
[ES] Caza {@LinkCreature:45#3004#acechadores athakela} alrededor de {@Rgn:45009} y recolecta sus colmillos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the fangs to {@LinkCreature:245#3511#Volvur}.
[ES] Entrega los colmillos a {@LinkCreature:245#3511#Volvur}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad I could help."
[ES] Me alegra poder ayudar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Argonomorph Tuwangi Blood
[ES] Sangre de tuwangi argonomorfo
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt {@LinkCreature:45#4002#argonomorph tuwangis} near {@Rgn:45009} and collect samples of their blood.
[ES] Caza {@LinkCreature:45#4002#tuwangis argonomorfos} cerca de {@Rgn:45009} y recolecta muestras de su sangre.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the blood to {@LinkCreature:245#3511#Volvur}.
[ES] Entrega la sangre a {@LinkCreature:245#3511#Volvur}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Eww. Good luck."
[ES] "Puaj. Buena suerte."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Rock on, Volvur."
[ES] "Sigue adelante, Volvur."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect argonite ore around the road south of {@Rgn:45009}.
[ES] Recolecta mineral de argonita alrededor del camino al sur de {@Rgn:45009}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the ore to {@LinkCreature:245#3511#Volvur}.
[ES] Entrega el mineral a {@LinkCreature:245#3511#Volvur}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
